audit_metadata.mode: READ-ONLY / AUDIT / NO SCORE / FROZEN INTACT / STOP
audit_metadata.discipline: Machine Error ≠ High Learning Value. Human Difficulty ≠ High Learning Value. Case 数量 ≠ Learning Value. 只寻找 Pre-review Case Value Signal Candidate, 不建score.

Case_A_machine_correct_human_confirms.definition: Machine 正确 + Human 确认
Case_A_machine_correct_human_confirms.evidence: Machine TN, human confirms <3s, 0 evidence expansions [OBSERVED]
Case_A_machine_correct_human_confirms.example: table cell pairs ('28.54' vs '10.02') — both machine and human trivially see different numbers
Case_A_machine_correct_human_confirms.what_system_learns: 几乎什么都没学到 — 机器已有证据, 人审只是确认

Case_B_machine_error_case_specific.definition: Machine 错误 + Human 修正, 但只针对单个实例
Case_B_machine_error_case_specific.evidence: Machine FP (MERGE), human corrects 2.2s snap; DCE-07 proved no safe fix; TLD page-global contamination case-specific [OBSERVED]
Case_B_machine_error_case_specific.what_system_learns: case-specific correction; no reusable pattern; DCE-07 closed locality route

Case_C_machine_error_reusable_mechanism.definition: Machine 错误 + Human 修正 + 背后存在重复的 Document Perception Failure Mechanism
Case_C_machine_error_reusable_mechanism.evidence: HVA-01: no Type C exists in current data [OBSERVED]
Case_C_machine_error_reusable_mechanism.what_system_learns: N/A — none found. 但 M-B 机制本身是 reusable (6 DIRECT cases), 只是当前 human review 把它们都当 snap judgment 处理了, 未提取信号.

Case_D_machine_uncertain_human_resolves.definition: Machine 不确定 + Human 能解决

learning_value_split.D_LOW: Human resolves as snap judgment (<5s, 0 expansion) → TEMPORARY value (Machine LOGIC GAP, info gain temporary)
learning_value_split.D_HIGH: Human resolves + 跨文档/跨页面/跨结构重复结构 → HIGH_POTENTIAL

Case_D_machine_uncertain_human_resolves.evidence: Info Gain Audit: 10/10 Quadrant B cases could be resolved by Machine with BETTER LOGIC → HIGH info gain is TEMPORARY [OBSERVED]
Case_D_machine_uncertain_human_resolves.what_system_learns: D_LOW: feedback confirms what human sees visually, no reusable signal extracted. D_HIGH: 未出现.

Case_E_human_also_uncertain.definition: Human 也无法确定 → UNKNOWN / BOUNDARY
Case_E_human_also_uncertain.evidence: Adjudicated cases (reviewer disagreement): AMB-005/375/418/519; 2 had 7 expansions + UNKNOWN [OBSERVED]
Case_E_human_also_uncertain.what_system_learns: genuine boundary; learning value in BOUNDARY DEFINITION (when should system abstain), not correction

Q11.1_what_did_selection_optimize.evidence: Pipeline: Geometry Filter (same_y, close_x, h_gap) → Ambiguity Filter (IS-01/IS-02 mixed) → Sampling. Optimizes geometric proximity + machine uncertainty, NOT expected system improvement per judgment. [OBSERVED]
Q11.1_what_did_selection_optimize.result: 53% Type A (machine already correct, wasted); 88% TABLE content bias; 0 REFERENCE, 0 OTHER_AMBIGUOUS in IS-11

Q11.2_cases_where_system_learns_nothing.evidence: Machine correct, human snap <3s, 0 expansion; or machine abstain, human snap <5s, 0 expansion [OBSERVED]
Q11.2_cases_where_system_learns_nothing.detail: table cell pairs where both machine and human trivially see different numbers/cells. Human uses page visual, not machine evidence.

Q11.3_cases_that_could_produce_new_failu.answer: AMB-375 (reviewer disagreement → abstain boundary); P7 BODY_TEXT_CONTINUATION (27) / REFERENCE_LIST_ENTRY (16) — missing types in IS-11
Q11.3_cases_that_could_produce_new_failu.evidence: AMB-375: adjudicated, B2 UNKNOWN, 7 expansions → genuine boundary where 'when should system abstain' [OBSERVED]. P7 has 39% PROSE + 23% REFERENCE vs IS-11 7%+0% → could reveal sentence/reference boundary mechanisms absent in IS-11 [OBSERVED]
Q11.3_cases_that_could_produce_new_failu.mechanism_potential: M-F (prose) + OTHER (reference continuation) are F_genuine_semantic_boundary — currently UNDERREPRESENTED

Q11.4_cross_doc_cross_page_cross_structu.answer: Caption (cross-framework 6.08%); Header (cross-corpus APS template); Table cell column (3 docs); Reference list (P7 16 cases cross-doc)
Q11.4_cross_doc_cross_page_cross_structu.evidence: M-A caption: Phase3 79/1299 cross-framework [OBSERVED]. M-D header: cross-corpus APS [OBSERVED]. M-B table: 2-3 docs ≥6 settings [OBSERVED]. P7 REFERENCE: 16 cases [OBSERVED]

Q12_l3_to_l5_chain_validation.chain_question: Human Answer → Feedback → New Information → Reusable Pattern → Validated Signal → Algorithm Hypothesis → Algorithm Improvement → Future Replay. 每步是否有证据?

new_information.evidence: 91% of feedback is BOUNDARY_CONFIRMATION (no new info); only 9% contains new information (correction) [OBSERVED]

reusable_pattern.evidence: 3 signal candidates all TEMPORARY_MACHINE_GAP; features already in P1/P2; info gain in rule-discovery layer not feature layer [OBSERVED, L3 audit]

validated_signal_L4.evidence: No candidate reached L4 (Human-Validated Reusable Signal); all 3 fail L4 9-criteria [OBSERVED]

algorithm_hypothesis.evidence: PH-01/02/03 are design-only hypotheses; PH-02 REJECTED 15/15; no algorithm improvement derived from human feedback [OBSERVED]

algorithm_improvement.evidence: No algorithm changed as result of human feedback [OBSERVED]

future_replay_L5.evidence: 0 future cases validated; CS1 at R3 highest, none at R5 [OBSERVED]

Q12_l3_to_l5_chain_validation.chain_verdict: NOT_DEMONSTRATED — 链条在 L3 (Candidate Discovery) 停滞. L4→L5→L6 全部 NOT_ACHIEVED. 不因有 SignalCandidate 文件就认为 Learning 已发生.

stability_novelty_paradox.finding: Stable signals are redundant (Machine already has evidence); Novel signals are unstable (Human reviewers disagree) [OBSERVED]
stability_novelty_paradox.implication: 当前 human feedback 既难以产生稳定新信号 (stable=redundant), 也难以产生可靠新信号 (novel=unstable). 这是 L3→L5 的结构性障碍, 非工程问题.

image_confound.finding: Human uses page visual, not machine evidence. 83% TLD failures resolved as snap judgments using visual inspection [OBSERVED]
image_confound.implication: Human feedback is NOT evidence-grounded in most cases → feedback cannot improve machine evidence path. This is why HVA-09 real-human test was repositioned (collect first real feedback, not prove pack quality).

current_case_selection_reality.genuine_value: 5 (11%) Type E, but only 2/5 high engagement

current_case_selection_reality.ceiling_effect: 96% KEEP_SEPARATE in IS-11 → no negative cases (same evidence → different feedback) → cannot learn boundaries

human_role_redefinition.principle: Human 不应替机器做大量普通判断. Human 价值应逐渐变成: 确认机器无法自行确定、但一旦确认就可能推动系统改进的高价值 Failure/Boundary.
human_role_redefinition.current_state: Human 做了大量普通判断 (87% low value). 69% decisions <3s, 96% no expansion, 96% only 1 level [OBSERVED]
human_role_redefinition.target_state: Human review cost ↓ + Evidence Quality ↑ + Reusable Improvement ↑ + Future Failure ↓ + VGA Evidence Reliability ↑
human_role_redefinition.gap: 当前 Human feedback 既不 evidence-grounded (image confound) 也不 reusable (no L4). 需先解决 Case Selection (L2) + Evidence Distillation (L3) 再谈 Human scaling.
human_role_redefinition.note: 这些是真正需要 Human 的, 但当前 selection 把大量 Type A 也送给人审 → 浪费.
